'''Traggissk Reosss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] and a member of [[Winnard Clan]].

==Biography==

Traggissk was a wing-commander for his clan until they attacked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy on the border of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. The Empire retaliated immediately and decimated Winnard Clan, with the exception of Traggissk and clan leader [[Broont Cloone]].<ref name="GC6" />

Cloone told the Empire of Traggissk's existence and admitted that he likely had no knowledge of the convoy's Imperial ties. However, in order to gain justice for the members of Winnard Clan, Cloone placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Traggissk's head. When it was discovered that Traggissk may have been working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Empire further increased the bounty.<ref name="GC6" />
